2610.08244.title: Sensor-Language-Action Models
2610.08244.paper_summary: Sensors are useful not only for understanding the world but also for deciding what to do next. Existing sensor models however largely stop at perception: they recognize states or predict outcomes, leaving actions modeled separately through task-specific and often closed label spaces. We introduce Sensor-Language-Action (SLA) modeling, a framework that connects multimodal sensor observations, natural language, and actions within a unified model. SLA uses language as a semantic interface between sensing and acting, allowing heterogeneous actions to be represented, predicted, and explained while remaining grounded in the underlying sensor evidence. We build a large-scale SLA benchmark consisting of datasets that span more than 116,000 individuals, 79 sensor modalities, and 60 action groups, together with a multi-faceted captioning pipeline that aligns user context, sensor dynamics, and action evidence. Building on this framework, we present OpenSLA, a unified SLA model for hierarchical action prediction, state understanding, and action explanation. Extensive experiments on real-world tasks in clinical prediction, operating rooms, and metabolic health verify its superior performance over the state-of-the-art. OpenSLA also demonstrates intriguing capabilities including language-guided evidence grounding and zero-shot generalization to unseen actions and cohorts.
2610.08244.paper_summary_zh: 感測器不僅對理解世界有用，還對決定下一步行動具有重要意義。然而，現有的感測器模型在感知方面基本上停滯不前：它們識別狀態或預測結果，將行動單獨建模，通常通過特定任務的封閉標籤空間。我們引入了感測-語言-行動（SLA）建模，這是一個將多模態感測觀察、自然語言和行動連接在統一模型中的框架。SLA使用語言作為感知與行動之間的語義介面，允許異質行動被表示、預測和解釋，同時仍然基於底層的感測證據。我們建立了一個大規模的SLA基準，包含超過116,000個個體、79種感測模態和60個行動組的數據集，以及一個多面向的標註管道，該管道對齊用戶上下文、感測動態和行動證據。在此框架的基礎上，我們提出了OpenSLA，一個統一的SLA模型，用於層次行動預測、狀態理解和行動解釋。在臨床預測、手術室和代謝健康等現實世界任務上的廣泛實驗驗證了其優於最先進技術的卓越性能。OpenSLA還展示了引人注目的能力，包括語言引導的證據基礎和對未見行動和群體的零樣本泛化。
